# rebar-ui

Headless-first, low-fidelity React components (real Radix UI underneath, styled via `--rebar-*`
CSS custom properties).

For an LLM/coding agent: read `dist/index.d.ts` for the exact prop interface of every component
(one compact file, ~220 lines) instead of the `.tsx` source under `src/components/`. See
`README.md` for install steps and composition recipes.
